BatteryPoint.description: Planned battery level after an action.
BatteryPoint.title: BatteryPoint

CandidateTrace.description: One UAV considered for a task, for the "Explain this assignment" panel.
CandidateTrace.title: CandidateTrace

CostWeights.description: Weights of ``C_ij = w_d·D̂ + w_e·Ê + w_t·T̂ + w_l·L̂``.
CostWeights.title: CostWeights

EnergyConfig.description: Scenario-wide switches for the energy model.
EnergyConfig.title: EnergyConfig

Event.description: A mission change. Which optional fields apply depends on ``type``.
Event.title: Event

FeasibilityRequest.description: ``assignment`` maps each UAV id to its ordered task ids.
FeasibilityRequest.title: FeasibilityRequest

GenerateRequest.description: Give a ``preset`` id, or ``params`` for a random scenario.
GenerateRequest.title: GenerateRequest

GridSpec.description: A ``width`` × ``height`` cell map; each cell is ``cell_size`` metres wide.
GridSpec.title: GridSpec

Leg.description: One flown leg: to a task, to a charging stop, or the final return.
Leg.title: Leg

LegPaths.description: One leg under both path metrics, for showing that shortest is not always cheapest.
LegPaths.title: LegPaths

ObjectiveBreakdown.description: Raw totals plus their normalized, weighted contributions to ``Z``.
ObjectiveBreakdown.title: ObjectiveBreakdown

ObjectiveWeights.description: Weights of ``Z``; ``lam · M · P_j`` is charged per unassigned task.
ObjectiveWeights.title: ObjectiveWeights

Obstacle.description:
A rectangle (inclusive cell bounds) or polygon (cell coordinates).

``obstacle`` and ``no_fly`` regions remove cells from the graph; ``blocked`` cells
added mid-mission use ``cells``. ``energy_zone`` regions stay flyable but multiply
the energy of edges inside them.
Obstacle.title: Obstacle

PathCompareRequest.description: Legs to price under both path metrics.
PathCompareRequest.title: PathCompareRequest

PlanResult.description: ``plan`` is null when a large instance became the background job ``job_id``.
PlanResult.title: PlanResult

PresetPreview.description: Just enough of a scenario to draw a thumbnail.
PresetPreview.title: PresetPreview

Route.description: A UAV's complete plan: ``[start, j1, ..., jk, station]``.
Route.title: Route

Scenario.description: Everything a planner needs. Mid-mission replans use a derived scenario.
Scenario.title: Scenario

ScenarioMeta.description: How a mission is presented. All values are illustrative simulation settings.
ScenarioMeta.title: ScenarioMeta

Task.description: Task ``J_j = (p_j, P_j, S_j, E_task, dur_j, deadline_j, mandatory, release_j)``.
Task.title: Task

TerrainLayer.description:
A typed map region, drawn on the map and optionally affecting flight.

``blocked`` removes its cells from the graph. ``energy_multiplier`` scales the energy of
edges inside it, through the same cell multipliers as an ``energy_zone`` region.
TerrainLayer.title: TerrainLayer

UAV.description: UAV state ``U_i = (p_i, B_i, B_i^max, C_i, T_i, v_i, P_cruise, P_hover, status, home)``.
UAV.title: UAV

Wind.description:
A uniform wind. ``direction_deg`` is the compass bearing it blows towards.

0° points up the map (increasing ``y``) and 90° points right (increasing ``x``).
``k`` is the sensitivity ``k_w`` in the leg energy factor.
Wind.title: Wind

info.description: Energy-aware route planning and battery feasibility. All values are simulated and illustrative, in normalized energy units unless stated.
info.title: Optimizing Routing, Task Allocation, and Energy Management in Collaborative UAV Systems
